title: Ribogreen Assay - 2 Standards and up to 8 Samples
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Arrange samples in tuberack
steps.instruction: Place the samples in the sample tuberack (slot 1) in the following order: A1 → sample 1, B1 → sample 2, C1 → sample 3, D1 → sample 4, A2 → sample 5, B2 → sample 6, C2 → sample 7, D2 → sample 8. Refer to the linked Part 1 and Part 2 files if needed.

steps.title: Input protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required protocol parameters in the fields provided above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware to OT App
steps.instruction: In the OT App, navigate to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and select the labware JSON files (.json) to upload, if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol file to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the OT App, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck hardware and labware on the robot exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette; consult the support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the assay.
